### PCIe Gen5 x4 M.2 2280 SSD

## CHARGING AHEAD WITH SPEED

From the MSI universe comes storage with blazing speeds and incredible performance. Take your system to the next level with SPATIUM.

 

Read 10,300 MB/s 

Write 8,700 MB/s

 Disclaimer: Performance may vary based on system hardware & software configuration. 

## PCIe 5.0

Get excited for next-generation storage performance that unites the latest PCIe Gen 5 controller technology and state-of-the-art 3D NAND flash, providing up to 1.8 times faster read/write speeds compared to the previous generation SSDs.

## LEAPS

The SPATIUM M560 delivers immense performance and capabilities that effortlessly handle even the most extreme gaming or productivity workflows, representing a significant advancement over PCIe 3.0 and SATA technologies.

 PCIe 5.0 Up to 20x

 PCIe 3.0 Up to 7x

## FULFILL UNLIMITED POTENTIAL

Built-in data security and error-correction capabilities extend the endurance and longevity of the NAND flash storage, empowering you to break records in games or take your talents to the next level. 

### Freeing Up Space

 

#### TRIM

To process unnecessary data efficiently and extend the life of SSD for more games or content creations.

### Gaining Controls

#### S.M.A.R.T

To Monitor the health of the drive and identify possible issues, letting you be free from worry in games or at work.

### Error Removal

#### ECC

To maintain your important records or files intact and ensure a nonstop gaming experience from system failure.

### Steady Transfer

#### E2E DATA PROTECTION

To enable reliable data transfer and assist you to game and create in confidence with enhanced system stability.

## A THOROUGH SHORTCUT WITH DIRECTSTORAGE

DirectStorage accelerates loading times in gameplay and high-resolution rendering, enhancing system performance by enabling hardware decompression directly from NVMe drives to GPUs and freeing up CPU resources for multitasking.

### BUILT TO WIN

With the gamers’ first attitude, SPATIUM SSDs optimized for high-performance bandwidth and throughput enable you to wait less at loading games and play to win with minimal latency.

...

## Real-Time SSD Monitoring & System Stability

Monitor SSD health and key metrics in real time through MSI Center. Stay informed with live updates on drive condition, enabling proactive management to ensure stable and reliable system performance.

- #### Drive Health
- #### Performance Metric

## OPTIMAL M.2 SSD

Designed in the M.2 2280 form factor, SPATIUM SSDs are easy to install into desktops, bringing speedy performance and power efficiency to any computing system.

 

## SPATIUM M560 PCIe 5.0 NVMe M.2

- PCIe Gen5x4 interface and complies with the NVMe 2.0 standard 
- Sequential Read speeds up to 10,300MB/s and Write speeds up to 8,700MB/s
- Up to 1200 TBW
- Built-in data security and error-correction capabilities
- 1TB to 2TB capacities in M.2 2280 form factor
- Suitable for both desktop and notebook
- 5-Year Warranty
